data.name: Spell-Like Ability
data.description: A seascarred skinwalker with a Wisdom score of 11 or higher can use charm animal (aquatic animals only) once per day as a spell-like ability, using his Wisdom modifier to determine his concentration checks. The caster level for this ability is equal to the skinwalker's character level.
